newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BANKS GROW BY 5.4 PCT IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: BANKS GROW BY 5.4 PCT IN JUNE.

text.p: The total assets of Estonia's commercial banks grew by 5.4 percent or 1.5 billion kroons in June to 29.28 billion kroons, the central bank said on Tuesday.
The total loan portfolio grew by 4.8 percent or 734 million kroons to 16 billion kroons, it added in a statement.
Total deposits increased by 2.8 percent or 485 million kroons to 17.69 billion kroons.
The total net profit of the country's commercial banks was 466.2 million kroons at the end of June, up 12.2 percent or 51 million kroons from the previous month.
